# Agent Guide for Naive UI

This file provides guidance to AI coding agents when working on the [Naive UI](https://github.com/tusen-ai/naive-ui) repository.

## Important Notes

- Vue 3 + TypeScript component library. Source is in `src/`.
- Package manager: pnpm (`11.10.0`). Node: `>=20`.
- Use English in code and comments. Keep comments meaningful and concise.
- Do not change public APIs or user-facing behavior unless requested.

## Build and Development Commands

```bash
# Start documentation site dev server
pnpm run dev

# Run all unit tests
pnpm run test

# Run tests for a specific component
pnpm run test src/button

# Update snapshots
pnpm run test:update

# Lint code and types
pnpm run lint

# Auto-fix lint issues
pnpm run lint:fix

# Format code
pnpm run format

# Full library build
pnpm run build:package

# Production docs site build
pnpm run build:site
```

## Architecture Overview

```
naive-ui/
├── src/                  # Component library source
│   ├── _internal/        # Internal helper components
│   ├── _mixins/          # Shared composables: useTheme, useConfig, useFormItem, etc.
│   ├── _styles/          # Global theme tokens
│   ├── _utils/           # Utility modules
│   ├── <component>/      # One directory per public component
│   │   ├── index.ts      # Public exports
│   │   ├── src/          # Component implementation (.tsx)
│   │   ├── styles/       # Theme vars (light.ts / dark.ts / _common.ts / rtl.ts)
│   │   ├── demos/        # Documentation demos
│   │   └── tests/        # Vitest specs
│   ├── composables/      # Public composables
│   ├── locales/          # i18n locale objects
│   ├── themes/           # Theme definitions
│   ├── components.ts     # Aggregated component exports
│   ├── preset.ts         # Default plugin
│   ├── create.ts         # Plugin factory
│   └── vitest-setup.ts   # Test environment polyfills
├── demo/                 # Documentation site source
├── build/                # Custom Vite plugins and build helpers
├── scripts/              # Build/release scripts
├── themes/tusimple/      # Tusimple-branded theme overrides
├── generic/              # Generic Vue component wrappers
├── esm-test/             # Smoke test for ES build
├── umd-test/             # Smoke test for UMD build
└── coverage/             # Vitest coverage output
```

## Component Conventions

- Props are declared as `componentProps` and exported from `index.ts`.
- Component implementation lives in `src/Component.tsx` using `defineComponent` + JSX.
- Styles live in `src/styles/index.cssr.ts` as CSS-render strings.
- Theme variables live in `styles/light.ts`, `styles/dark.ts`, and `styles/_common.ts`.
- Tests live in `tests/Component.spec.tsx`.

## Key Development Patterns

- Use shared mixins from `src/_mixins/`: `useConfig`, `useTheme`, `useThemeClass`, `useFormItem`, `useLocale`, `useRtl`.
- CSS class naming follows BEM: `.n-button`, `.n-button--primary`, `.n-button__icon`.
- Theme variable naming follows `<component><State><Variant>` order, e.g. `buttonColorErrorHover`.
- Use named imports and `h` from `vue` for JSX.

## Code Style

- Do not fix formatting manually. Use `pnpm run lint:fix` and `pnpm run format` to let the tools handle it.
- Prettier: `semi: false`, `singleQuote: true`, `printWidth: 80`, `trailingComma: none`.
- ESLint: `@antfu/eslint-config` with a few project-specific overrides.
- File naming: kebab-case directories, PascalCase component files.
- TypeScript strict mode enabled.

## Testing Approach

- Vitest with `jsdom` and `@vue/test-utils`.
- `src/vitest-setup.ts` polyfills browser APIs.
- When a change only affects a single component, run only that component's tests first: `pnpm run test src/<component>`.
- Add tests for new props or behaviors. Keep tests focused.

## Commit Message Format

Use Angular style:

```
feat(button): add ghost prop
fix(input): handle empty value correctly
docs: update contributing guide
```

## Pull Requests

- Prefer the `gh` CLI when interacting with GitHub (listing PRs, checking CI status, creating PRs, etc.).
- Always follow `.github/pull_request_template.md` when creating a PR.
- Keep PR titles and descriptions factual and concise.
- Do not add AI-tool branding or co-author trailers.
- If public APIs or user-facing behavior change, update docs and call out the impact in the PR template.

## Debugging

- Use `chrome-devtools-mcp` (Chrome DevTools Protocol) for browser debugging: inspecting elements, capturing screenshots, monitoring network requests, running performance traces, and executing scripts in the page context.

## Useful References

- `package.json` — scripts, dependencies
- `vite.config.mts` — dev server, aliases, test config
- `tsconfig.json` — TypeScript config
- `eslint.config.mjs` — lint rules
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — contribution workflow
- `design-notes/maintaining.md` — release process
- `design-notes/how-to-name-a-style-var.md` — theme variable naming guide

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install Elm packages without going through github.com/zipball (which is blocked
# in this environment). Downloads the same source tarballs from codeload.github.com
# and unpacks them into $ELM_HOME/0.19.1/packages/<author>/<project>/<version>/.
#
# Usage:  scripts/install-elm-packages.sh [author/project@version ...]
#         scripts/install-elm-packages.sh            # installs the default set
#
# Respects ELM_HOME (default: $HOME/.elm-home).
set -euo pipefail

ELM_HOME="${ELM_HOME:-$HOME/.elm-home}"
VERSION_DIR="0.19.1"
root="$ELM_HOME/$VERSION_DIR/packages"

install_pkg() {
  local spec="$1"
  local author project version
  author="${spec%%/*}"
  project="${spec#*/}"; project="${project%%@*}"
  version="${spec##*@}"
  local dest="$root/$author/$project/$version"

  if [ -f "$dest/elm.json" ]; then
    echo "  = $author/$project $version (cached)"
    return 0
  fi
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  local url="https://codeload.github.com/$author/$project/tar.gz/refs/tags/$version"
  if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 180 "$url" -o /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz; then
    echo "  ! failed to download $author/$project $version from $url" >&2
    rm -rf "$dest"
    return 1
  fi
  tar -xzf /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz -C "$dest" --strip-components=1
  rm -f /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz
  echo "  + $author/$project $version"
}

DEFAULT_PKGS=(
  elm/core@1.0.5
  elm/json@1.1.3
  elm/html@1.0.0
  elm/virtual-dom@1.0.3
  elm/time@1.0.0
  elm/url@1.0.0
  elm/browser@1.0.2
  mdgriffith/elm-ui@1.1.8
)

pkgs=("$@")
if [ ${#pkgs[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  pkgs=("${DEFAULT_PKGS[@]}")
fi

echo "ELM_HOME=$ELM_HOME"
for p in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
  install_pkg "$p"
done
echo "done."

type Mode

type alias Theme =
    { mode : Mode

    }


default : Theme

    { mode = Light, common = Common.light }


dark : Theme

withCommon : (Common -> Common) -> Theme -> Theme

setPrimary : String -> Theme -> Theme
setPrimary color theme =

                , primaryColorHover = Color.createHoverColor color

module NUI.Theme exposing
    ( Mode(..)
    , Theme
    , dark

{-| The theme is Naive UI's "common" variable set plus a mode flag. Component
themes are derived from it (exactly like Naive UI's `self(vars)`).
-}

import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Theme.Common as Common exposing (Common)


type Mode
    = Light
    | Dark


type alias Theme =
    { mode : Mode
    , common : Common
    }


light : Theme
light =
    { mode = Light, common = Common.light }


dark : Theme
dark =
    { mode = Dark, common = Common.dark }


default : Theme
default =
    light


withMode : Mode -> Theme -> Theme
withMode mode theme =
    case mode of
        Light ->
            { theme | mode = Light, common = Common.light }

        Dark ->
            { theme | mode = Dark, common = Common.dark }


{-| Escape hatch: tweak the raw common variables.
-}
withCommon : (Common -> Common) -> Theme -> Theme
withCommon f theme =
    { theme | common = f theme.common }


{-| Override the primary colour family, deriving hover / pressed / suppl like Naive UI.
-}
setPrimary : String -> Theme -> Theme
setPrimary color theme =
    withCommon
        (\c ->
            { c
                | primaryColor = color
                , primaryColorHover = Color.createHoverColor color
                , primaryColorPressed = Color.createPressedColor color
                , primaryColorSuppl = Color.createHoverColor color
            }
        )
        theme

module NUI.Internal exposing
    ( Kind(..)
    , Size(..)
    , classIf
    , classes
    , cssVars
    , kindClass
    , sizeClass
    , toAttrs
    )

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| Naive UI size scale.
-}
type Size
    = Tiny
    | Small
    | Medium
    | Large


sizeClass : Size -> String
sizeClass size =
    case size of
        Tiny ->
            "tiny"

        Small ->
            "small"

        Medium ->
            "medium"

        Large ->
            "large"


{-| Naive UI status/colour scale (its `type` prop).
-}
type Kind
    = Default
    | Primary
    | Info
    | Success
    | Warning
    | Error


kindClass : Kind -> String
kindClass kind =
    case kind of
        Default ->
            "default"

        Primary ->
            "primary"

        Info ->
            "info"

        Success ->
            "success"

        Warning ->
            "warning"

        Error ->
            "error"


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


classIf : Bool -> String -> Attribute msg
classIf cond c =
    classes (List.filter (always True) [ c ] |> List.filter (\_ -> cond))


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute made of `--n-*` custom properties.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"


toAttrs : List String -> List ( String, String ) -> List (Attribute msg)
toAttrs classList vars =
    [ classes classList, cssVars vars ]

module NUI.Css exposing
    ( css
    , element
    , layout
    , rootAttribute
    )

{-| Ships Naive UI's stylesheet and the scope marker it relies on.

The CSS is generated from Naive UI's own cssr sources (see `tools/`) and embedded so
the package is self-contained — no separate `.css` import needed. Every rule is
scoped under `.nui-root`, so an ancestor element must carry the marker class.
`layout` (drop-in for `Element.layout`) sets it for you, and `element` renders the
stylesheet node.

    view model =
        NUI.Css.layout []
            (Element.column [ spacing 16 ]
                [ NUI.Css.element
                , NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults [ Element.text "Hello" ]
                ]
            )

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Html
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| The full stylesheet as a string (for a `<link>`/inline `<style>` approach).
-}
css : String
css =
    Generated.all


{-| A `<style>` node. Include it once near the root of your app.
-}
element : Element msg
element =
    Element.html (Html.node "style" [] [ Html.text css ])


{-| The class the generated stylesheet is scoped under. Add it to (an ancestor of)
your components.
-}
rootAttribute : Attribute msg
rootAttribute =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.class "nui-root")


{-| Drop-in replacement for `Element.layout` that adds `rootAttribute`.
-}
layout : List (Attribute msg) -> Element msg -> Html.Html msg
layout attrs content =
    Element.layout (rootAttribute :: attrs) content

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Kind(..)
    , Options
    , Size(..)
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ I.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ I.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true" ]

            else
                [ HA.attribute "role" "button"
                , HA.tabindex 0
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
            :: (interactive |> List.map Element.htmlAttribute)
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.circle || opts.round then
                    height

                else
                    borderRadius
              )
            ]
    in
    [ ( "--n-bezier", common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-bezier-ease-out", common.cubicBezierEaseOut )
    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )
    , ( "--n-opacity-disabled", v.opacityDisabled )
    , ( "--n-wave-opacity", v.waveOpacity )
    ]
        ++ fontVars
        ++ colorVars
        ++ borderVars
        ++ sizeVars


customColorVars : Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
customColorVars maybeColor =
    case maybeColor of
        Nothing ->
            []

        Just color ->
            let
                hover =
                    Color.createHoverColor color
            in
            [ ( "--n-border-color", color )

message.content: Now the Button reference implementation — the pattern the other components will follow.

arguments.content:
module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Kind(..)
    , Options
    , Size(..)
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ I.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ I.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true" ]

            else
                [ HA.attribute "role" "button"
                , HA.tabindex 0
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
            :: (interactive |> List.map Element.htmlAttribute)
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.circle || opts.round then
                    height

                else
                    borderRadius
              )
            ]
    in
    [ ( "--n-bezier", common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-bezier-ease-out", common.cubicBezierEaseOut )
    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )
    , ( "--n-opacity-disabled", v.opacityDisabled )
    , ( "--n-wave-opacity", v.waveOpacity )
    ]
        ++ fontVars
        ++ colorVars
        ++ borderVars
        ++ sizeVars


customColorVars : Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
customColorVars maybeColor =
    case maybeColor of
        Nothing ->
            []

        Just color ->
            let
                hover =
                    Color.createHoverColor color
            in
            [ ( "--n-border-color", color )
            , ( "--n-border-color-hover", hover )
            , ( "--n-border-color-pressed", Color.createPressedColor color )
            , ( "--n-border-color-focus", hover )
            , ( "--n-border-color-disabled", color )

        Primary ->

module NUI.Types exposing (Kind(..), Size(..), kindClass, sizeClass)

{-| Public enums shared by every component (Naive UI's `size` and `type`).
-}


{-| Naive UI size scale.
-}
type Size
    = Tiny
    | Small
    | Medium
    | Large


sizeClass : Size -> String
sizeClass size =
    case size of
        Tiny ->
            "tiny"

        Small ->
            "small"

        Medium ->
            "medium"

        Large ->
            "large"


{-| Naive UI status / colour scale (its `type` prop).
-}
type Kind
    = Default
    | Primary
    | Info
    | Success
    | Warning
    | Error


kindClass : Kind -> String
kindClass kind =
    case kind of
        Default ->
            "default"

        Primary ->
            "primary"

        Info ->
            "info"

        Success ->
            "success"

        Warning ->
            "warning"

        Error ->
            "error"

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"

type Kind
    = Default
    | Primary
    | Info
    | Success
    | Warning
    | Error


kindClass : Kind -> String
kindClass kind =
    case kind of
        Default ->
            "default"

        Primary ->
            "primary"

        Info ->
            "info"

        Success ->
            "success"

        Warning ->
            "warning"

        Error ->
            "error"

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"

# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

# elm-naive-ui

[Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components for Elm, built on
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/) — aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original, not an "inspired by" approximation.

```elm
view model =
    NUI.Css.layout []
        (Element.column [ Element.spacing 12 ]
            [ NUI.Css.element
            , NUI.Button.view theme
                { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Types.Primary }
                [ Element.text "Primary" ]
            ]
        )
```

## How it works

Naive UI renders a component from two things: a static stylesheet of BEM rules
(`.n-button`, `.n-button:hover`, …) and per-instance `--n-*` CSS custom properties for
the themed values. This library ships **Naive UI's own CSS** (extracted verbatim from
its sources) and sets the **same `--n-*` values from Elm**, attaching both to elm-ui
elements.

So the pixels come from Naive UI's CSS, and elm-ui provides the composition API.

Concretely, for a button this project emits:

```html
<div class="… s r n-button n-button--default-type n-button--medium-type"
     style="--n-color:rgb(24,160,88);--n-height:34px;…">
```

### Relationship to elm-ui

elm-ui's helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, …) would otherwise override Naive UI's
rules on shared properties. Two things keep Naive UI in control:

- every Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root`, which out-specifies elm-ui's
  single/double-class rules. Add the marker with `NUI.Css.layout` (or `NUI.Css.rootAttribute`).
- a small bridge (`tools/bridge.css`) restores `flex-basis` / `white-space` for elements
  Naive UI styles but does not declare those properties on.

## Theme

`NUI.Theme.Theme` is Naive UI's *common* variable set plus a light/dark mode. Component
variables are derived from it exactly like Naive UI's `self(vars)`, so overriding the
common vars (or the primary colour) propagates everywhere.

```elm
theme =
    NUI.Theme.default
        |> NUI.Theme.setPrimary "#7c3aed"

darkTheme =
    NUI.Theme.dark
```

The full variable sets are extracted from Naive UI, so all values are the originals.

## Components

| Module            | Status |
| ----------------- | ------ |
| `NUI.Button`      | ✅ |
| `NUI.Input`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Card`        | ✅ |
| `NUI.Tag`         | ✅ |
| `NUI.Alert`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Checkbox`    | ✅ |
| `NUI.Switch`      | ✅ |
| `NUI.Radio`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Divider`     | ✅ |
| `NUI.Space`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Typography`  | ✅ |
| `NUI.Avatar`      | ✅ |

## Development

```bash
# 1. install the Elm packages (github.com zipballs are blocked in some sandboxes;
#    this fetches from codeload.github.com instead)
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home ./scripts/install-elm-packages.sh

# 2. build the library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# 3. build + inspect the example page (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html
node ../tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs index.html .n-button

# 4. regenerate the CSS + theme modules from the Naive UI checkout
cd tools && npm install && npm run extract   # NAIVE_UI_SRC=/path/to/naive-ui
```

See [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the component conventions.

## Notes / limitations

- Static rendering only: components render the correct markup, classes and themed
  values. Interactive behaviour (focus management, transitions on mount, virtualised
  lists, portalled overlays) is not implemented — those are Vue-runtime concerns.
- `css/naive-ui.css` is generated; do not edit it by hand.
- Licence: MIT. Naive UI is MIT too; the extracted CSS originates from that project.

## Licence

MIT

   testing — keep the public API unchanged. Prefer adding a thin exported helper like
   `cssVarsFor : Theme -> Options msg -> List (String, String)`.
6. `NUI.Css.css`: contains `.n-button`, is scoped (contains `.nui-root.nui-root`), and
   contains the bridge rule for `flex-basis`.

  `src/NUI/Button.elm`. Do NOT touch generated files (src/NUI/Theme/*, src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm),

  Naive UI styles but does not declare those properties on.

## Theme

`NUI.Theme.Theme` is Naive UI's *common* variable set plus a light/dark mode. Component
variables are derived from it exactly like Naive UI's `self(vars)`, so overriding the
common vars (or the primary colour) propagates everywhere.

```elm
theme =
    NUI.Theme.default
        |> NUI.Theme.setPrimary "#7c3aed"

darkTheme =
    NUI.Theme.dark
```

The full variable sets are extracted from Naive UI, so all values are the originals.

## Components

| Module            | Status |
| ----------------- | ------ |
| `NUI.Button`      | ✅ |
| `NUI.Input`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Card`        | ✅ |
| `NUI.Tag`         | ✅ |
| `NUI.Alert`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Checkbox`    | ✅ |
| `NUI.Switch`      | ✅ |
| `NUI.Radio`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Divider`     | ✅ |
| `NUI.Space`       | ✅ |
| `NUI.Typography`  | ✅ |
| `NUI.Avatar`      | ✅ |

## Development

```bash
# 1. install the Elm packages (github.com zipballs are blocked in some sandboxes;
#    this fetches from codeload.github.com instead)
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home ./scripts/install-elm-packages.sh

# 2. build the library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# 3. build + inspect the example page (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html
node ../tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs index.html .n-button

# 4. regenerate the CSS + theme modules from the Naive UI checkout
cd tools && npm install && npm run extract   # NAIVE_UI_SRC=/path/to/naive-ui
```

See [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the component conventions.

## Notes / limitations

- Static rendering only: components render the correct markup, classes and themed
  values. Interactive behaviour (focus management, transitions on mount, virtualised
  lists, portalled overlays) is not implemented — those are Vue-runtime concerns.
- `css/naive-ui.css` is generated; do not edit it by hand.
- Licence: MIT. Naive UI is MIT too; the extracted CSS originates from that project.

| Failures | Cause |
|---|---|
| `parse "#0f0"/"#ff8800"/"#ABC"`, `createHoverColor "#666666"`, `createPressedColor "#666666"`, `changeColor "#666666" 0.5` | **Bug A** — `parseHex` does `String.toInt ("0x" ++ pair)`, but elm/core 1.0.5's `String.toInt` accepts **only decimal** (see `Elm/Kernel/String.js`, digits `0x30..0x39`). Every hex colour parses to `Nothing`, so hex-based `createHover/PressedColor`/`changeColor`/`setPrimary` silently return the input unchanged (`createHoverColor "#666666"` → `"#666666"`). |
| `createHoverColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)"`, `createPressedColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)"` | **Bug B** — `toCss` emits `rgb(r, g, b)` when `a >= 1`; seemly always emits `rgba(r, g, b, a)`, so the correct output is `"rgba(76, 165, 146, 1)"` / `"rgba(37, 130, 110, 1)"`, not `"rgb(76, 165, 146)"`. |

Expected values are naive-ui's own spec (`src/_utils/tests/index.spec.ts`): `'rgba(126, 126, 126, 1)'`, `'rgba(76, 165, 146, 1)'`, `'rgba(90, 90, 90, 1)'`. (The task text omitted the `, 1` alpha; seemly never drops it.)
